name: Sarah
intro: Sarah has been helping dogs and their people learn together since 2000. As CHeWs’ Principal Instructor, she brings decades of practical experience to every class.
detail: Sarah is a canine first aider and a Royal Kennel Club Good Citizen Dog Scheme examiner at all levels. At home she shares life with Dougal, a rescue crossbreed with Gold GCDS and a Bronze sniffer dog award, and Toby, a Norfolk Terrier with Bronze GCDS and eight first places at Crufts.

name: Su
intro: Su has been part of the CHeWs daytime team since 2018 and brings a lifetime of dog ownership to her classes.
detail: She teaches across all Royal Kennel Club Good Citizen levels and is a canine first aider. Her dog Alfie, a Labrador/Poodle/Bearded Collie cross, has achieved Gold and is also a therapy dog.

name: Tony
intro: Tony has been with CHeWs since 2013 and brings a wonderfully varied background to the team, from science teaching and sailing instruction to photography.
detail: A lifelong dog owner, Tony is a senior daytime instructor, canine first aider and Silver Royal Kennel Club Good Citizen assessor. His dogs Apollo and Chester have achieved Gold and Silver GCDS respectively.

name: Ben
intro: Ben joined CHeWs after completing three years of animal care and management at college, and quickly discovered that two weeks of work experience simply was not enough.
detail: He now teaches Mixed Ability classes, supports instructors across all levels, and is both a canine first aider and Bronze Royal Kennel Club Good Citizen assessor.

name: Cliff
intro: Cliff joined CHeWs in 2017 with Kova, his yellow Labrador Retriever, and has been a valued part of the club ever since.
detail: Kova has achieved Gold GCDS and a Bronze sniffer dog award. Cliff is a canine first aider, instructor and Royal Kennel Club Good Citizen assessor at all levels. He and Kova won the Joyce Dobson Shield for Dedication to Training in 2019.

name: Rebecca
intro: Rebecca has been part of CHeWs since the very beginning and leads our Wednesday Gold and Platinum training.
detail: A respected dog groomer, canine first aider and Bronze Royal Kennel Club Good Citizen assessor, Rebecca brings a wealth of hands-on canine experience to the team.

name: Martin
intro: Martin combines his role as an instructor with an ongoing interest in modern, positive dog training.
detail: He has completed a range of Institute of Modern Dog Trainers courses, including puppy training, and continues to study motivation and positive reinforcement. Martin is a canine first aider and teaches at all levels. His English Springer Spaniel, Merlin, achieved Gold GCDS and worked in search and rescue before retiring.

name: Trevor
intro: Trevor keeps the practical side of CHeWs running smoothly — and, just as importantly, keeps the tea, coffee and jokes flowing.
detail: He helps look after the church hall and garden, supports classes and plays a big part in CHeWs fundraising events.
